jamie-peopleops: Quick Q  Ana submitted an off-cycle promotion for Mateo (US) with 4/1 effective and asked for retro to 3/15. Payroll cutoff is 3/20. Can we include retro in the next run?

ana-eng-manager: Yes please include retro. Title change SWE II -> SWE III, salary 120k -> 135k. Manager evidence uploaded.

rachel-payroll: If you submit before 03/20 23:59 PT we can include it in the next run. Otherwise it will be a correction on the following check and show as separate line item.

sam-talentcomp: For equity band bump, we need a 1-line leveling rationale + comp calibration note. Equity can be deferred; salary change doesn't need comp committee hold-up.

jamie-peopleops: Action: Ana paste short rationale here, attach org lead signoff, and submit retro form (internal.forms/retro-us).

ana-eng-manager: Rationale: "Promoted for ownership of cross-service routing and consistent execution on latency improvements." Org lead signoff uploaded. Submitted retro form ID RETRO-2389.

rachel-payroll: Got RETRO-2389. Ticket PAY-US-2026-412 created. Expect processing in 2 business days.

ledger-bot: Note: retro correction will update YTD and require ledger reconciliation. Finance will receive notice when payroll posts.

jamie-peopleops: Thanks team  closing loop; reopen if any exceptions.
